newsitem.title: THAILAND: Seamico halted on new partner talks.
newsitem.headline: Seamico halted on new partner talks.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) said on Tuesday it had halted trading in Seamico Securities Plc shares pending talks between the brokerage and a prospective foreign partner.
"Seamico Securities informed the SET it was finalising an investment in Seamico from a foreign financial institution in order to increase its net capital," it said.
Seamico said it would clarify the outcome of the talks by August 29.
The company said it would continue operating normally during the negotiations.
The finance and securities industry is going through a transition as it adjusts to harsher economic conditions in Thailand.
Finance and securities companies have been hard hit by the severe Thai economic downturn and regulators have suspended the business of 58 cash-strapped firms.
Seamico was last traded at 8.20 baht on Monday.
